abstract: The role of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in diagnosing the ovarian cyst was reviewed with emphasis on its diagnostic value of endometrial cyst. 94 cystic ovarian masses in 77 patients were evaluated using 0.15 Tesla MRI just before laparotomy at Okayama University Hospital from 1984 to 1987 and these images were followed up by histopathological data. From these obtained images, 6 parameters; that is (1) laterality and (2) delineation of the cyst, (3) presence or absence of septal image, and (4) homogeneity, (5) signal intensity and (6) T1 value of the cyst contents, were extracted and analyzed respectively. In 95.5% of endometrial cysts, homogenous internal pattern was observed in all 3 images (short spin echo (SE), inversion recovery (IR) and long SE) and its signal intensity was at the same level or higher than that of myometrium. On the other hand, in all cases of follicular cyst, para-ovarian cyst, corpus luteum cyst and in 95.0% of serous cystadenoma and in 90.9% of mucinous cystadenoma, cyst contents showed either lower signal intensity than the myometrium or similar to it in T1 contrast images (short SE and IR). 93.1% of dermoid cyst showed heterogenous signal intensity in all 3 images and their signal intensity levels were widely ranging. High signal intensity of cyst contents in all 3 images could be observed in 72.7% of endometrial cyst, 5.0% of serous cystadenoma with internal hemorrhage, 9.1% of mucinous cystadenoma with internal hemorrhage and 3.4% of dermoid cyst consisted of fatty tissue only. Endometrial cyst showed markedly shortened T1 value (209.6 +/- 102.7 ms) and the other hemorrhagic cyst showed comparatively short value (360-970 ms). On the other hand, T1 value of non hemorrhagic cyst was as high as the level of urine. All of endometrial cysts were clearly defined from the other pelvic structures. In result, endometrial cysts were found to exhibit the characteristic findings in MRI images such as homogenous high signal intensity of internal fluid and clear delineation of cyst contour. The diagnostic accuracy of MRI in endometrial cyst were considered 96.8% in our cases.
abstract_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性腫瘤の画像診断における磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の役割を、子宮内膜嚢胞の診断的価値に焦点を当ててレビューした。1984年から1987年に岡山大学病院で、開腹術の直前に0.15テスラのMRIで評価された患者77例の卵巣嚢胞性腫瘤94例を対象とした。これらの組織病理学的データと照合した。画像から、(1)左右の別、(2)嚢胞の輪郭の描出、(3)隔壁像の有無、(4)均一性、(5)嚢胞内容物の信号強度、(6)嚢胞内容物のT1値という6項目を抽出し、それぞれ解析した。子宮内膜嚢胞の95.5%では、3つの画像（short spin echo（SE）、inversion recovery（IR）、long SE）すべてで均一な内部パターンが認められ、その信号強度は筋層と同等かそれ以上であった。一方、全例の濾胞嚢胞、傍卵巣嚢胞、黄体嚢胞、および漿液性嚢胞腺腫の95.0%、粘液性嚢胞腺腫の90.9%では、T1強調画像（short SEおよびIR）で嚢胞内容物の信号強度が筋層より低いか、それと同程度であった。類皮嚢腫の93.1%は3つの画像すべてで不均一な信号を示し、その信号強度は広範囲にわたっていた。出血を伴う子宮内膜嚢胞の72.7%、出血を伴う漿液性嚢胞腺腫の5.0%、出血を伴う粘液性嚢胞腺腫の9.1%、脂肪組織のみからなる類皮嚢腫の3.4%では、3つの画像すべてで嚢胞内容物が高信号を示した。子宮内膜嚢胞のT1値は著しく短く（209.6 ± 102.7 ms）、その他の出血性嚢胞はやや短い値（360〜970 ms）を示した。一方、非出血性嚢胞のT1値は尿と同程度に高かった。子宮内膜嚢胞はすべて、他の骨盤内構造から明瞭に区別された。結論として、子宮内膜嚢胞は、内部液体の均一な高信号と嚢胞輪郭の明瞭な描出といった特徴的なMRI所見を示すことが判明した。本症例における子宮内膜嚢胞のMRI診断精度は96.8%と考えられた。
